title: Promotion!
text: Your boss noticed your hard work. Move up to the next level of your career.

title: Employee of the Month
text: Your team voted for you. Win the next accessory of your career level.

title: Torn Uniform
text: Coffee spill on the job! Lose your last career accessory unless you have a shield.

title: Training Day
text: You aced a training course at the Dogzy Academy. Collect 150 tokens.

title: Big Tip
text: A VIP customer loved your service and leaves a generous tip.

title: Job Interview
text: Answer a quiz. Pass it to win the next accessory of your career.

title: Late for Work
text: You overslept after a night in Dogzy Town. Your boss docks 75 tokens from your pay.

title: Franchise Deal
text: Your brand is growing. Collect 50 tokens for every business you own.

title: Mentor a Rookie
text: You train a new apprentice. Give 50 tokens to the poorest player and win a career accessory.

title: Health Inspection
text: The inspector visits your shops. Pay 25 tokens for every business you own.
